tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and chart surface: figures sit directly on the page like a printed plate, never in cards. Also the 2px gap between touching marks and the 2px ring around dots.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the table view, the only things that float above the page.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The 'How to read this chart' panel and editor's sidebars. Text on it is `ink` (13.9:1 light, 12.3:1 dark) or `ink-3` (4.6:1 light, 5.1:1 dark). Never a data mark.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The electric-blue Signal plate (Figure variant `signal`): a ground for ONE hero chart or section opener per page, drawn in `on-signal`. Never a data colour on paper; use `series-1` for that.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and the single data series on a `signal` ground (7.0:1).

tokens.name: on-signal-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ticks and source lines on a `signal` ground (5.0:1).

tokens.name: signal-line
tokens.usage: Gridlines on a `signal` ground. Recessive by design (1.4:1); never carries data.

tokens.name: signal-context
tokens.usage: De-emphasised context marks on a `signal` ground (2.6:1); values stay reachable through the table view.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, titles and the figure's top rule, on `paper` (15.7:1 light, 15.7:1 dark), `paper-raised` and `butter`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Deks, annotations, value labels and tooltip series names on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `butter` (8.5:1 light, 10.4:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Axis ticks, kickers, source lines and notes on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `butter` (5.2:1 light, 6.4:1 dark on paper). The faintest text colour in the system.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 2px rule above every figure and stat tile, and the table header rule. An alias of `ink`.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and table row dividers: 1px, solid, never dashed. Recessive by design (1.2:1); gridlines never carry data on their own.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: The zero baseline, tick marks, control borders and the tooltip border (3.1:1 light, 3.05:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: mark-context
tokens.usage: De-emphasised data: the grey lines, bars and dots that give context to the one highlighted series (2.0:1 light, 2.3:1 dark). Below 3:1 on purpose, so any chart using it must keep the table view and tooltips on.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on `paper` and `paper-raised` (5.6:1 light, 5.3:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1, ultramarine. Also THE emphasis colour: the one series the story is about, with everything else in `mark-context`. Assign slots in order 1→8 and never cycle.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2, vermilion. Also the semantic 'bad / event happened' colour in icon arrays.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3, ochre. Slots 1–4 stay distinguishable for every pair, so scatter and small-multiple charts may use up to four.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4, rose. Last slot allowed in scatter, maps and small multiples; four series or more must also be direct-labelled.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5, moss. Lines, bars and stacks only (only neighbouring slots were checked for pairs from here on).

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6, sky. Lines, bars and stacks only.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7, violet. Lines, bars and stacks only.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8, teal. The ceiling: a ninth series folds into 'Other' or small multiples, never a new hue.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ultramarine, lowest bin. Heatmaps and choropleths only: it may recede into `paper` because it means 'near zero'.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3. The lightest step allowed for ordered discrete marks (funnel stages, tiers): it clears 2:1 on `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5.

tokens.name: seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential step 6.

tokens.name: seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential ultramarine, highest bin. Darkest on Paper, brightest on Ink: 'more' always reads as more ink against the ground.

tokens.name: div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Diverging vermilion arm, furthest below the midpoint.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging vermilion arm, step 2.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging vermilion arm, nearest the midpoint.

tokens.name: div-0
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: a neutral grey that reads as 'no difference'. Never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging ultramarine arm, nearest the midpoint.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging ultramarine arm, step 2.

tokens.name: div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Diverging ultramarine arm, furthest above the midpoint.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: A delta that is good news, as text with its ▲/▼ glyph and sign, on `paper` (5.5:1 light, 8.0:1 dark). Blue-cyan, not green, so it never depends on red–green vision.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: A delta that is bad news, as text with its glyph and sign, on `paper` (6.6:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Caveats and data-quality warnings in notes, always preceded by the word 'Note' or 'Caution' (5.5:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

families.sans: "Sofia Sans Semi Condensed", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Newsreader carries the words: headlines, chart titles, deks, body and annotations. Its optical-size axis is set per style.

styles.name: t-headline
styles.usage: One per page: the story or dashboard headline.

styles.name: t-title
styles.sample: Harbor's ridership recovered a full year before the other lines
styles.usage: Figure titles. Always the takeaway, written as a sentence in sentence case with no full stop.

styles.name: t-dek
styles.sample: Weekday boardings, indexed to January 2019 = 100. Illustrative data.
styles.usage: The line under a title: what was measured, in which unit, for whom, when.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: A chart can be read faster than the paragraph that explains it, but only if it was built to be read.
styles.usage: Running text around figures; 60–75 characters per line.

styles.name: t-annotation
styles.usage: On-chart callouts, joined to their data by a hairline leader, and the How-to-read panel.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, light and tall: the signal-plate voice. Numbers and section openers only; never paragraphs.

styles.name: t-hero
styles.usage: The ONE hero number a page leads with. Proportional figures.

styles.name: t-section
styles.usage: Section openers on a `signal` plate, set in capitals in the copy itself.

groups.name: Chart
groups.note: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed sets everything inside the plot. Semi-condensed so labels stay horizontal; never rotate text.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Direct labels, legend entries, category names.

styles.name: t-label-strong
styles.usage: The highlighted series' label and panel titles in small multiples.

styles.name: t-tick
styles.usage: Axis ticks, set with tabular figures.

styles.name: t-value
styles.usage: The value in a tooltip row: values lead, labels follow.

styles.name: t-table
styles.usage: Table view and data tables, tabular figures, numbers right-aligned.

groups.name: Meta
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for the machine layer: kickers, provenance and code.

styles.name: t-kicker
styles.usage: The kicker above a title: figure number and topic, in capitals.

styles.name: t-source
styles.sample: Source: City transit authority (2025) · Data and code ↓
styles.usage: Source lines, notes, sample sizes and links under every figure.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Code and raw values in documentation.

spacing.note: 4px base. Figures breathe: space-5 between header and plot, space-6 between figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Swatch-to-label gap, tick-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Kicker to title, title to dek, legend item gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Plot to footer, inside tooltips and the How-to-read panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header to plot; stat-tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top padding of a figure under its rule; gaps between stat tiles; signal-plate padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between small-multiple rows; between a figure and running text.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between figures in a long read.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks; around a signal plate.

radius.note: Print-square. The only rounding is the barely-there data end of a bar.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Figures, plates, panels, tables, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: The data end of a bar (square at the baseline), tooltips, buttons, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots and markers only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One soft lift for the tooltip, which floats over data.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips only, together with a 1px `axis` border.

mark.note: Fixed mark specs, read by the bundle. Thin marks, two spacers (gap and ring), generous hit targets.

tokens.name: bar-max
tokens.usage: Maximum bar or column thickness; leftover band space stays air.

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Data lines, round joins and caps.

tokens.name: line-width-context
tokens.usage: Context lines in `mark-context`.

tokens.name: marker-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of end dots and scatter points (r = 4).

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: The `paper` ring around dots where they cross lines or each other.

tokens.name: gap-width
tokens.usage: The `paper` gap between stacked segments and touching bars.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hover and focus target around any mark.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: The `rule` above figures, stat tiles and table headers.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Gridlines, axes, leaders, footer rule.

tokens.name: area-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of an area wash or uncertainty band under its line's colour.
